subject: Confirmation of Your Travel Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], We are pleased to confirm your travel booking for the upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight details are as follows: Flight: ABC123, Departure: May 15th, 2022 at 10:00 AM, Arrival: May 15th, 2022 at 2:00 PM. Please review the attached itinerary for more information. Should you have any questions or require further assistance, feel free to contact our customer service team. We wish you a pleasant journey! Best regards, Travel Agency Team
